'''Edern Lars''', the [[Reproduction/Legends|son]]<ref name="CL" /> of [[Gredda Lars/Legends|Gredda]] and [[Lef Lars/Legends|Lef Lars]],<ref name="Annual" /> was a younger<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|80|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|brother]] to [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He<ref name="CL" /> [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> when at age fourteen he lost control of his [[Lars family/Legends|family's]] [[V-35 Courier/Legends|V-35 Courier]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. He was buried with a tombstone on his family's [[Lars homestead/Legends|property]] on Tatooine.<ref name="CL" /> In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]], Cliegg's wife, was buried next to the graves of Edern and and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="CL" />
